summary_text: On this weekday evening, the user purchased one 400 g pack of Flipkart Supermart Fusilli pasta and one 400 g pack of Flipkart Supermart Penne pasta. This single order aligns with the population baseline for evening activity (30.27% share). The products are standard dry pasta shapes typically used as quick-cook meal bases. As this is a single observed order on one date, it does not establish a durable brand preference for Flipkart Supermart or a specific shape preference for fusilli or penne over other pasta types. It is unclear if this represents a routine pantry restock or a one-off meal preparation.
